title: Midnight Grace Blouse
imageAlt: Midnight black blouse with maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery
summary: An elegant black blouse featuring delicate maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery with subtle scattered motifs.
description: Midnight Grace brings understated elegance through a deep black fabric base, intricate maroon and antique-gold embroidery, and delicate scattered embellishments. The neckline features a beautifully detailed embroidered border, complemented by matching sleeve borders and subtle metallic motifs across the blouse. The back showcases a wide U-shaped neckline with decorative tie strings and tassel detailing.

specs.workType: Aari Embroidery · Gold Threadwork · Bead Embellishment

priceIncludes: Hand embroidery work on the customer-supplied blouse or garment, including the design consultation and the work shown in the listed design.
priceExcludes: Courier charges, the blouse/garment itself, and any extra material changes beyond the listed design are quoted separately.
shippingNote: The customer sends the blouse or saree by courier to the studio; the completed piece is returned by tracked delivery after the embroidery is finished.
